metadata.purpose: Full SHT FFT-target comparison of the radix-11 odd-ido-tail kernel after removing a SIMD bundle field that affected unrelated code layout.
metadata.workload: All current exact C2C and real SHT target operation/length cells; one-transform and scalar/spin-1 row batches; one transform thread
metadata.timing: Six alternating process pairs; seven warmed samples per operation
metadata.compiler: Rust 1.99.0 stable; optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime AVX2 dispatch
metadata.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X; process pinned to logical CPU 30
metadata.dispatch_note: The f64 AVX2 radix-11 dispatcher processes odd final inner values across adjacent outer-group pairs when l1 >= 2. A final odd outer group uses the scalar path. N=682's dedicated ido=31 kernel and inverse safety fallback remain unchanged; f32 and CPUs without AVX2 retain scalar processing.
metadata.layout_note: The odd-tail kernel is called from the existing radix-11 dispatcher. The generic SimdKernels bundle is unchanged.
metadata.previous_capture: m26-radix11-odd-tail-six-pairs.jsonl measured an earlier dispatch layout; its large non-target slowdowns are retained as diagnostic and are not the result for this source patch.
metadata.runner: ../m24-radix103/run_m24_clean_capture.py records process IDs, uptime, and load averages before, during, and after each run, and fsyncs every JSONL record.
